config.address_order: layer, batch, kv_head, physical_block; separate K payload, V payload, K parameters, V parameters; token-major within each stream
config.immediate_rmw: Read complete intersecting transactions. Append writes complete transactions; preserve prior valid bytes by RMW when append starts inside a transaction. New transaction unused bytes are initialized without a read. No masked writes or cross-step cache reuse; attention tail transactions are discarded before append and cannot supply the RMW read.
config.combined: Retain one transaction per stream. Read pending valid bytes on chip, complete prefix transactions from memory. Flush at transaction completion, physical-block end, request end or eviction. Frozen windows start and end on transaction boundaries; partial end flush and resume seed reads are recorded separately in boundary tests.
config.current_token: Quantize with stored parameters, then reconstruct locally for attention; append once, no off-chip readback in the same step. No high-precision current-token bypass.
config.execution: Layers serial. Quantize current KV; pipeline K read, decode, optional rotation, QK; full-history softmax barrier; pipeline V read, decode, AV; append write completes before next layer. Dedicated stages, double tile buffers, shared K/V link in sequential phases. No cross-layer overlap.
config.decode_rate_unit: values/s including unpack, integer conversion, parameter conversion and stored-parameter multiply/add
config.pipeline_resource_condition: Separate memory, decode, rotation and dot-product engines; at most two live tiles across the pipeline, with backpressure. Separate KV tile, parameter and score SRAM banks; KV read and write ports sustain simultaneous producer/consumer demand, otherwise serialize or extend schedule. Parameter broadcast once per group; GQA shares one decoded KV head. Actual rates must be measured at this concurrency, not isolated peak rates.
config.rope_coefficients: Generate cos/sin for 64 distinct frequencies per position, once per decode step; retain FP32 cos/sin table across layers and heads on chip. Capacity (history+1)*128*4 bytes. Generation throughput, loading frequencies and dynamic scaling setup are explicit common per-model inputs, not zero-time assumptions. Table spills require extra off-chip bytes.
config.intermediates: Two FP32 tiles per active K/V phase, shared across sequential layers; FP32 logits/probability array retained on chip per layer. KV tile write+read and softmax traffic counted separately; no full-history FP32 KV cache.
